summary: 10/10 backend tests passed (9 pre-existing + 1 new), 7/7 new browser checks passed. All 8 acceptance criteria in this briefing exercised.

checks.name: hero-shows-service-badges
checks.evidence: hero-door-to-door-badge, hero-refund-badge ('100% Refund if Delivery is Delayed'), hero-delivery-badge ('Delivery Within 24 Hours') all visible alongside hero-title and both hero CTAs (hero-book-consultation-button, hero-explore-services-link) unobscured.

checks.criterion: Dedicated guarantee section is clear and actionable
checks.name: guarantee-section-shows-doorstep-cta
checks.evidence: service-guarantee-section visible with guarantee-title 'Legal help at your door...', guarantee-description mentioning '100% fee refund', why-choose-grid, and book-door-to-door-button CTA.

checks.criterion: All original expertise areas are represented
checks.name: complete-services-directory-shows-all-31
checks.evidence: complete-services-list rendered exactly 31 [data-testid^='complete-service-name-'] rows; clients-served-copy contained 'Multinational corporations', 'Growing startups', and 'Individual clients and investors'.

checks.name: why-choose-grid-shows-all-ten
checks.evidence: why-choose-grid rendered exactly 10 [data-testid^='why-choose-text-'] items; spot-checked text for 24x7, door-to-door, transparent pricing, PAN India, confidentiality, technology, and client-first reasons.

checks.name: complete-services-directory-shows-all-31
checks.evidence: Same check also asserted door-to-door-pricing-fee contains '999' and refund-pricing-copy contains '100%' within the public complete-services section.

checks.name: test_pricing_catalogue_contains_door_to_door_entry_at_999_plus_travel
checks.evidence: GET /pricing -> 200, 42 items; entry with 'door-to-door' in name has fee containing both '999' and 'travel'.

checks.name: guarantee-section-shows-doorstep-cta
checks.evidence: Clicking book-door-to-door-button set booking-mode-select value to 'Door-to-door service' and scrolled the booking-form into view.

checks.name: mobile-service-cta-preselects-doorstep
checks.evidence: At 390x844 viewport, mobile-service-cta bar visible with mobile-door-to-door-button ('Book Door-to-Door') and mobile-refund-guarantee ('100% Delay Refund'); hero-title still visible (not blocked); clicking the button set booking-mode-select to 'Door-to-door service'.

checks.name: core-public-flow-healthy
checks.evidence: No pageerror/requestfailed events fired; hero and booking-form rendered; pricing search for 'property' reduced pricing-filter-count below 'Showing 42 of 42'; submitted a tscheck- fixture booking and booking-reference-value appeared.
